Maya: FYI noticed a few small tenants were auto-fallbacked overnight by rollout c-204 after a single latency outlier. Noisy. :grimacing:
Aj: ugh. Is this the sparse-trigger problem? We evaluate over 10s window and a single 5xx flips it if sample lands on it.
Sophia: can we add a min_requests thresh (eg min_requests=10) and require either failures>=3 OR confidence>0.8 before triggering? Small customers shouldn't be deterministically flipped.
Maya: also ops got spammed with individual inbox items for each fallback. Need grouping.
Nate: proposal: debounce per-route/customer + group inbox events by group_id (policy_id+route+customer hash). Also add sticky_override_ttl so ops can silence for 1h.
Aj: config sketch in console UI: ```
fallback.trigger = error_rate
fallback.min_requests = 10
fallback.window_secs = 30
fallback.debounce_secs = 300
fallback.audit_sample = 0.02
group_inbox_by = policy_id
```
Liam: telemetry: emit decision_confidence, group_id, sampled_payload_id. Store tiny snapshot (reason_code, counts, mv_avg_latency, payload_key). Full payload cold-store on demand.
Sophia: agree but keep sample rate low to avoid egress. Snapshot must be <1KB.
Nate: edge-case: very tiny customers might still need protection. Add symmetric rule: if total_requests < 5 and any severe_error (5xx or OOM) then allow fallback but mark for manual_review and require operator ack.
Maya: add runbook step: manual-review flow pings oncall + CSM if customer > $threshold.
OpsBot: deploy/canary autofallback-sparse-fix branch finished: canary=20% :white_check_mark:
Aj: PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/8123 includes config + telemetry + inbox grouping. @Maya @Nate PTAL.
Maya: thanks. Also add metric fallback_noisy_group_count for product to track small-customer noise.
Liam: will add chart to console and a slack notify rule (pager suppressed).
Nate: ensure group_id stability across restarts (persist in audit event).
Sophia: I'll draft the runbook + telemetry schema by EOD. Aj will add unit tests for grouping/debounce.
Maya: plan: Aj PR today, Sophia runbook EOD, Ops monitor canary.
